about.heading: About
paragraphs: I built H2 Studio from scratch: a one-person studio that turns ideas into cinematic video and web experiences. I work near Isfahan and collaborate with clients across Iran and worldwide.
My standard is simple: what I deliver has to be good enough that you want to show it off. You tell me what you want — I handle the rest.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.sub: Short, honest answers to the things everyone asks.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: There’s no fixed price list; every project is quoted on its scope and complexity. The Pricing section shows what drives the price, and the “Get an exact quote” wizard gives you your project’s price in minutes.
Anywhere from a few days to a few weeks depending on scope; we lock the exact timeline in the brief and stick to it.

items.q: How many revisions can I request?
items.a: The workflow is built so you see and approve a preview at every stage; revisions until you approve the result are a natural part of the process.

items.q: Is AI video quality really professional?
items.a: Yes — with a precise storyboard, locked references and human editing. Watch “Qatre”: a 56-second film made entirely with AI. AI is the tool; the cinematic eye is human.

items.q: What formats do I get on delivery?
items.a: Video as high-quality MP4, sized for each platform (Reels, YouTube, web). Websites ship as ready-to-publish files on your own host, with a management guide.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.sub: The exact quote comes after the brief — but these are the things that set it.
factors: Project type: AI video, cinematic website, app, or editing
Scope: video length, number of site pages, number of app features
Customization level: ready-made template vs. bespoke design
Ready content: do you have photos, copy and a logo, or must they be created?
Timeline: rush delivery compresses the production schedule
